event_records.description: The school board's first September meeting is scheduled to occur on a date in early September (e.g., September 8) and the second on a date later in September (e.g., September 22). The proposal is on the agenda for both meetings.

marlin_bay_unified_school_board_as_a_bod.name: Marlin Bay Unified school board (as a body)
marlin_bay_unified_school_board_as_a_bod.persona_brief:
You are Marlin Bay Unified school board (as a body).
The board has the proposal on its agenda for both September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November. The board operates under standard procedures: a recorded vote occurs when a trustee requests it or when the board chair decides to record it. The board is aware of the parent group's plan to pack public comment.

parent_group.name: Parent group
parent_group.persona_brief:
You are Parent group.
The group has promised to pack the public-comment period at the September meetings to advocate for the later-start-times proposal. They have no formal decision-making power on the board.

resolution.question: Will the Marlin Bay Unified school board take a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal at either of its two September meetings?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal actually occurred at either of the two September meetings (i.e., before the end of the second meeting, which is before the hard cutoff of 2026-09-30T22:00:00-07:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
